retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy urban collage featuring low-poly faceted portraits and jagged, hand-drawn angular typography against a vibrant blue geometric background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, vibrant composition utilizing a low-poly vector technique where subjects and backgrounds are constructed from sharp, angular geometric facets. The style features high-contrast shading, a dominant blue and black palette with warm skin tones, and integrated jagged typography that follows the chaotic energy of the background.
coreVisualRelationships: Faceted low-poly portraits integrated into a geometric background
Jagged, hand-drawn typography echoing the angularity of the vector art
High-contrast interplay between cool blue backgrounds and warm, faceted skin tones
Dense, overlapping composition with no flat negative space
coreInvariants: Sharp, non-curved geometric facets for all organic forms
Heavy black outlines or deep shadow planes separating color blocks
Consistent angularity in both imagery and letterforms

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two primary portraits positioned diagonally; one central and lower, one upper right, both scaled to fill the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central portrait's face, defined by high-contrast golden and brown facets.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: A circular flow following the curved paths of the text and the diagonal placement of the two heads.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Virtually non-existent; every area is filled with geometric patterns, text, or faceted shapes.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Black and Dark Brown (Shadows and outlines)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden Yellow and Ochre (Skin highlights and jewelry)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with extreme value shifts between adjacent facets to create form.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to high-contrast primary and secondary colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Angular, blocky sans-serif with irregular proportions
letterConstructionRules: Constructed from straight lines and sharp angles
Variable stroke widths with heavy, blocky terminals
Letters often tilt or follow curved paths while maintaining internal rigidity
characterSpecificRedesigns: M and W use sharp zig-zag strokes
O and U are rendered as multi-sided polygons rather than curves
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospace-style angularity where all text elements share the same jagged, hand-drawn DNA.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the faceted, low-poly aesthetic of the artwork.
Captures the urban, high-energy feel of the composition.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-poly vector illustration of two men in sunglasses, using sharp geometric facets. Use a palette of vibrant blue, black, and warm skin tones. Fill the background with abstract geometric shards and rays.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-drawn angular lettering that follows the curves and angles of the background shards. Ensure letters are blocky, jagged, and outlined in thick black.

verificationChecks: Are there any smooth curves in the portraits? (Should be none)
Is the text following a rigid horizontal line? (Should be dynamic/angled)
Is the blue background sufficiently vibrant and faceted?

mustRedesign: Any smooth gradients or airbrushed textures
Standard legible fonts without angular modification

mustAchieve: Consistent low-poly faceting across all elements

postGenerationChecks: Confirm all organic shapes are rendered as polygons.
Ensure text outlines match the thickness of the background geometric lines.
Verify that the color palette maintains high contrast between blue and gold tones.
Check that no negative space is left untextured or unpatterned.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-poly vector style + angular custom lettering + high-contrast geometric collage.
